apps.name: Super Mario Kart
apps.description: Native SNES recompilation of Super Mario Kart. The current published package is Windows-only and asks for your own USA ROM.
apps.blurb: Native SNES recompilation of Super Mario Kart. The current published package is Windows-only and asks for your own USA ROM.

apps.name: Mario Kart 64
apps.description: Static Nintendo 64 recompilation using N64: Recompiled and RT64. The project publishes Windows, macOS and Linux builds; check its README for the supported game dump and graphics requirements.
apps.blurb: Static Nintendo 64 recompilation using N64: Recompiled and RT64. The project publishes Windows, macOS and Linux builds; check its README for the supported game dump and graphics requirements.

apps.name: Mario Kart: Super Circuit
apps.description: Native Game Boy Advance recompilation. The current releases provide Windows and Linux x86-64 packages; follow the project instructions for your own ROM and any required BIOS files.
apps.blurb: Native Game Boy Advance recompilation. The current releases provide Windows and Linux x86-64 packages; follow the project instructions for your own ROM and any required BIOS files.

apps.name: Mario Kart DS
apps.description: Native recompilation of the European Mario Kart DS cartridge. The project provides its own launcher and setup flow; Linux and macOS packages are beta.
apps.blurb: Native recompilation of the European Mario Kart DS cartridge. The project provides its own launcher and setup flow; Linux and macOS packages are beta.

apps.name: Mario Kart Wii
apps.description: PowerPC static recompilation of Mario Kart Wii. The project provides a Windows setup program and Linux AppImage; check its README for supported disc regions and prerequisites.
apps.blurb: PowerPC static recompilation of Mario Kart Wii. The project provides a Windows setup program and Linux AppImage; check its README for supported disc regions and prerequisites.

apps.name: Mario Kart 7
apps.description: Mario Kart 7 Recompiled, including its launcher setup profile, per-game settings, save paths and 3GX plugin support for projects such as CTGP-7.
apps.blurb: Mario Kart 7 Recompiled, including its launcher setup profile, per-game settings, save paths and 3GX plugin support for projects such as CTGP-7.

apps.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
apps.description: Experimental Mario Kart 8 Deluxe recompilation. The current project publishes Windows packages; functionality and compatibility are still developing.
apps.blurb: Experimental Mario Kart 8 Deluxe recompilation. The current project publishes Windows packages; functionality and compatibility are still developing.

apps.name: Mario Kart World
apps.description: Early Mario Kart World recompilation with Windows and Linux x86-64 packages. It requires your own supported game dump and project-specific setup prerequisites.
apps.blurb: Early Mario Kart World recompilation with Windows and Linux x86-64 packages. It requires your own supported game dump and project-specific setup prerequisites.

apps.name: MKSC Neo
apps.description: Alternative native C/SDL3 re-implementation of Super Circuit, based on the original game's decompilation. Not the gbarecomp static recomp project. Publishes a universal macOS build and imports your own US ROM locally.
apps.blurb: Alternative native C/SDL3 re-implementation of Super Circuit, based on the original game's decompilation. Not the gbarecomp static recomp project. Publishes a universal macOS build and imports your own US ROM locally.

apps.name: Mario Kart Wii (Enhanced)
apps.description: Your enhanced Wiicompiled alternative. Releases include a Windows setup, macOS DMG and Linux AppImages. Uses the game's own setup flow and your own disc.
apps.blurb: Your enhanced Wiicompiled alternative. Releases include a Windows setup, macOS DMG and Linux AppImages. Uses the game's own setup flow and your own disc.
